mai.delivery-before: You have everything ready? <wiggle>Splendid!</wiggle> Then let us see to what this tavern needs to get going. Wait here a moment.
mai.delivery-after: There, you should be able to run the tavern for now! There is still work to be done, but you can put things right little by little. I look forward to seeing what you make of it.
mai.praise: You finally did it... I have never seen this tavern look so fine! <bounce>A splendid job!</bounce>
mai.memory:
...I never thought the sight of this place would make me feel this way.
When you first arrived, I did wonder how it would all turn out... but you have done rather well!
mai.home:
...Yes. I really am fond of this tavern.
<shake>Oi, what are you grinning at?!</shake> Get on with preparing to open!
